notes:
Status: closed-lost. Summary: Strong technical fit — POC showed performance and latency targets met for reranking/chat and doc search. Main fail point: Security team refused to provide SOC2 Type II report or ISO27001 certification evidence; cited legal/third-party audit NDA. We proposed redacted reports, letter of attestation, on-prem audit access, and tighter contract/KMS options; all declined. Procurement froze budget, internal champion left role, competitor (Anthropic managed) provided audit evidence and a dedicated compliance liaison and won procurement.

Call snippets / rep notes: 
- "We can't share our auditor report; it's contractual with our auditor. That's non-negotiable." — Sentinel InfoSec (08/27).
- "If you need full audit artifacts we can only accept vendors that provide SOC2 Type II or allow auditor-to-auditor exchange." — Procurement.
- POC: latency medians ~120ms, 95th ~210ms, costs within target for dedicated config. Engineering feedback positive.

Open items at time of close: none (procurement closed). Recommended follow-up: mark as lost-to-competitor, add to watchlist if Sentinel achieves SOC2/ISO or relaxes evidence policy. Re-engage in 6-9 months or when they publish compliance certs.
